subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Kestrel — decision for the demo review
body:
Team,

Decision for next Monday's review: we go with Rafael's option (a). The Kestrel demo locks extrapolation at 4x baseline, and the capture team's 8x ask moves to an H2 investigation with the stack-of-cards artifact examples attached so nobody relitigates this from a slide.

Supporting decisions:
1) Retrained checkpoint (internal captures) is the demo model — Freya's eval shows it beats the released pretrained model on our capture distribution, especially on texture realism at the extrapolation edge.
2) Rosa's screening heuristic ships anyway as a capture-time warning — flagging deep-parallax scenes at capture is useful even at 4x.
3) Nadia — requesting LRB sign-off at the Jun 26 board for a partner-facing demo in July. Materials will be under the Kestrel name in the shared drive by Thursday.

Great half, everyone. This one demos itself.

Lucia
